lines.speaker: annex_staffer
lines.text: Four names in both columns. Declared an interest in a perpetual counterparty in 2031, signed the Handover instruments in 2064, and the interest was declared correctly every single year in between.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: It was never hidden. That is what I keep running into. None of this was ever hidden, it was just filed.

lines.speaker: annex_staffer
lines.text: Take the gallery pass. Seat forty-one, third reading. Issued to somebody who did not come.
